steps.question: How dense is the layout?
steps.why: Room around the text helps reading.
Pills sit softly next to text.

steps.pick: radius.pill: We use a pill corner for badges in order to give status a role of its own, apart from the 8px controls. A full radius does this by rounding both ends into a capsule. So a status sits softly in the text and never reads as a button, because badges get their own corner (shape.roles) and the brand is warm (brand.q1).

steps.rule: A recessed fill, a step below content.
steps.pick: neutral.100, a step below content (1.12:1 on surface.default), so table headers and wells read as recessed.
steps.darkPick: neutral.100, a step below content (1.2:1 on surface.default), so table headers and wells read as recessed.

steps.question: How large is body text?
steps.why: Large body text is easy on the eyes.
Status is rare, so readers never learn an icon for it. A word is clear the first time.

steps.pick: inter for caption text: Source Serif 4 for reading and headings, Inter for labels and captions: a good magazine's text with a quiet interface.
neutral.700: supporting text, 9.75:1 on surface.default, above the 4.5:1 floor.
steps.darkPick: neutral.500: supporting text, 10.11:1 on surface.default, above the 4.5:1 floor.

steps.question: Which color roles does it need?
How many signals carry each meaning?
steps.why: Status is rare; color and a word are enough.
